words.gloss: those who do not weigh or calculate

literal: The benefit not-calculating done help, [its] goodness if-evaluated, greatness ocean-than is-greater.
translation: If one evaluates the true worth of a help rendered by those who did not calculate the return benefit, its greatness is vaster than the ocean.
modern: கைம்மாறு கருதாமல் ஒருவர் செய்த உதவியின் நன்மையை ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால், அதன் சிறப்பு கடலை விடப் பெரியதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the immeasurable value of selfless assistance. The word 'பயன்தூக்கார்' refers to those who act without weighing what they might get in return. When we analyze ('தூக்கின்') the inner worth ('நயன்') of such an unconditional act, we find that its spiritual and moral weight ('நன்மை') is far greater than the vastness of the ocean ('கடலின் பெரிது'). The poet uses the image of the ocean to show that selfless help transcends physical boundaries and calculations.
